cache_policy: Both runtime binaries and the complete original npm resolution tree are read/hashed outside measurement before each slot; filesystem cache is warmed by verification, with no drop_caches or cold-start claim.
measurement: whole measured client/MCP descendants; raw cpu.stat and charged memory.peak; monotonic clone-to-empty wall
memory_scope: Kernel charges to the fresh measured cgroup, including anonymous/client/server allocations; previously charged shared/file-cache pages remain with their original charge owner. This is not process-tree RSS or whole-host incremental memory.

records_encoding.array_order: pin.path ascending by Unicode code point
pin.path ascending by Unicode code point
